data.title: 毛利兰 · 海浪里的沙滩排球
data.description: 【湘南海岸·盛夏】小兰穿着蓝白运动泳装在沙滩上屈膝接球，身后的遮阳伞和海水被阳光照得发亮；她把球稳稳托起后朝镜头挥手，长发和笑容一起被海风带起。
data.action: 沙滩屈膝接球后朝镜头挥手，长发和笑容一起迎着海风扬起
data.lighting: bright summer sun with clean ocean reflections
data.promptProse: Ran Mouri from Detective Conan wears a blue-and-white sporty swimsuit with a light visor, ankle bands and a beach volleyball. She bends into a quick beach-volleyball receive, sending the ball cleanly over the bright sand. She turns to the viewer with one hand raised in greeting, her dark hair lifting in the wind as the calm waves and striped umbrellas make the athletic holiday feel effortless. bright summer sun with clean ocean reflections.
